issues.description: Default config points to data/stories, but the required story manifest and story files are absent, so extraction fails from a clean checkout.
Story loading hard-fails on external files with no tiny-mode built-in dataset or generation fallback despite the documented runnable demo.
The end-to-end test currently fails because it depends on missing data/stories inputs.
Validation loads vectors without checking manifest compatibility with the selected backend/model/d_model/layer count, allowing late crashes or invalid comparisons.
Preference steering also trusts vector manifests without backend/model/shape validation before combining saved vectors with a newly loaded backend.
HF dtype auto is treated as None and the model is loaded then moved manually, which can silently load large models in fp32 and cause avoidable memory failures.
When tokenizer offsets are unavailable, steering silently applies to every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
HF preference scoring is an absolute good-vs-bad next-token score, not an actual pairwise preference comparison as described by the README.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still returns one principal component, which is surprising for a public helper and config-controlled setting.
Generated demo artifacts are committed while their source data is missing, making the repo state stale and non-reproducible.
